en: {player}... There isn't much here, as you can see, but this is my home.
Thank you for everything you've done. Please take this as my thanks. It's an HM. You've earned it.
When you're out on the water with Surf, look for patches where the sea turns dark.
Use Dive there and you'll sink down to the sea floor. Use it again to come back up.
There are places down there where you can't come up, though. Keep that in mind.
They say there's an underwater cavern between Mossdeep and Sootopolis. The one Captain Stern found in his submarine.
{player} looked at the Poké Ball. There's a Beldum inside. Take the Poké Ball?
{player} left the Poké Ball where it was.
'{player}, I've decided to travel for a while and train on the road. I won't be home for some time.'
'I have a favour to ask. Please take the Poké Ball on the desk. Inside is Beldum, my favourite Pokémon.'
'I'm counting on you. May our paths cross again someday. Steven Stone'
